title: Adriatic to Aegean
subtitle: Split to Athens by boat, car and plane

cover.alt: Old town walls above the Adriatic

chapters.heading: Split, and the islands
chapters.body: The trip starts in Split, then heads straight out to sea on a boat cruise around the islands nearby before landing back in the city.

chapters.heading: An afternoon on Hvar
chapters.body: A quick hop across to Hvar for the afternoon, then back on the water.

chapters.heading: By sea to Dubrovnik
chapters.body: The long boat ride down the coast to Dubrovnik and its city walls.

chapters.heading: Inland to Sarajevo and Mostar
chapters.body: Swapping the boat for a car and heading inland into Bosnia and Herzegovina: first Sarajevo, then Mostar and its old bridge.

chapters.heading: The Bay of Kotor
chapters.body: Back to the coast on the road to Kotor in Montenegro, tucked deep inside its bay.

image.alt: Mountains around the Bay of Kotor
image.caption: Kotor.

chapters.heading: Tirana to Thessaloniki
chapters.body: Still driving: south into Albania for Tirana, then across to Thessaloniki in Greece.

chapters.heading: Santorini, then Athens
chapters.body: A flight out to Santorini, a ferry back to Athens, and from there, home.
